acceptance: The three round-3 probes each give a refusal, and each test is red on the current walker
The design page states the fail-closed model and its review passed
Commit 6 (test 10) does not start before this item is closed
fix: Design pass first, then architecture and adversarial review: load the whole module (not the import closure) so every write is seen; refuse the boxing of any type from an exec-reaching std package and of os/exec types; treat any reached function value that flows anywhere other than a call or the named sysexec.RunFunc as reached. Record the model in docs/architecture/gate-contract-g2-hermetic-guard.md 7.4 and 7.5.
source: console, 2026-11-11, operator ruling after the third failed review round of G2 commit 3
summary: The operator ruled on 2026-11-11 that gatehermetic (G2 commit 3, ADR-0165) lands as a measuring tool after three review rounds each found new false passes. Three are open (internal-gatehermetic.md, Known false passes): a boxed exec-reaching std type such as cgi.Handler behind http.Handler; a function value inside a composite-literal initializer argument; a write to a code-holding package var from a package outside the load closure. The pattern is structural: the walk passes each Go shape that no rule names.
title: Make the G2 walker fail closed at its source before commit 6 enforces it
